{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss | DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓","id":"gh:1342084531","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-ponytail","slug":"Wenaixi/dsh-ponytail","topics":["agent-skills","ai-agents","claude-code","code-review","cordis","cursor","deepseek","deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","kv-cache","lazy","llm","over-engineering","ponytail","prompt-caching","prompt-engineering","typescript","yagni"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills wit"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"h bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss | DeepSeek Harness 插件：Diet"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"richGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-ponytail"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The best code is the code you never wrote."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) port of DietrichGebert/ponytail, maintained independently (ADR-0010). Injec"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ts the 7-rung ladder directly into system prompts, provides 6 specialized skills, and registers zero"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"7-rung ladder directly into system prompts, provides 6 specialized skills, and registers zero tools."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A counter-weight to LLM boilerplate and over-engineering: deletion over addition, boring over clever"},{"id":"p7s2","text":", and fewest files possible. Challenge requirements before writing code (YAGNI), prioritize existing"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" functions and standard libraries, and solve in one line when possible."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Features a **Zero Cache Miss Architecture** (ADR-0012): session baseline is locked permanently, and "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"dynamic intensity switches take effect via turn-end reminders, leaving historical prompt / KV cache "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"100% untouched across long conversations. Ships as a pure `dsh.bundle`, writes zero garbage to your "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"home root, uninstalls cleanly, and rebuilds itself through HMR."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Needs the DSH runtime (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`). Node and pnpm floors are in the badges above. E"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"xamples use the `web` profile; substitute your own profile name."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Intensity levels reset on each new session according to `env > Profile patch > fallback full`. There"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"fore, `/ponytail <level>` is session-scoped. To persist across restarts and new sessions, use `/pony"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"tail default <level>`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Zero Cache Miss Architecture"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"When switching intensity levels within an ongoing session or updating global default configurations,"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" the top-level SystemPrompt baseline remains **strictly byte-identical and static**."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Mode transitions take effect dynamically by appending an incremental system notification (`<system-r"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"eminder>`) at the end of the current turn's user message (aligned with the official `dsh-tool-skill`"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" catalog update pattern, ADR-0012). This **100% protects historical KV Cache / Prompt Cache** across"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" all multi-turn conversation history, eliminating costly prefill recalculations and latency spikes."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Skills"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Skill | Description |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `/ponytail` | Core mode: 7-rung ladder, lazy senior dev mindset |
| `/ponytail-review` | Over-engi"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"neering code review: hunt for code that can be deleted |
| `/ponytail-audit` | Whole-repo complexity"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" audit, ranked by deletion yield |
| `/ponytail-debt` | Harvest `ponytail:` comments into an actiona"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ble debt ledger |
| `/ponytail-gain` | Minimal metrics dashboard showing code reduction benchmarks |"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"
| `/ponytail-help` | Quick reference card for modes, commands, and skills |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Skill Bodies and Description Languages"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Skill bodies are retrieved directly from upstream DietrichGebert/ponytail v4.10.3 in verbatim Englis"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"h. Two host-incompatible details are tailored for DSH: `ponytail-gain` data sources point to `assets"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"/*.svg` (as upstream `benchmarks/` is excluded), and `ponytail-help` configuration and update sectio"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ns reference profile patches and `dsh plugin`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Model catalog views and configuration forms share the exact same description string, governed by `sk"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"illDescriptionLang` (three-state: explicit Chinese `zh` / explicit English `en` / unconfigured `auto"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"`). When unconfigured, it follows the host's `locale.preference` (English triggers English alignment"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"; others default to Chinese). Explicit selection locks the language. Canonical descriptions reside i"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"n `skills/descriptions.zh.json` and `skills/descriptions.en.json`, served live via `ctx.remote.ponyt"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ptions.zh.json` and `skills/descriptions.en.json`, served live via `ctx.remote.ponytail.snapshot()`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Configuration Panel"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The card detail view provides an embedded settings panel: intensity level control, independent toggl"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e switches for all 6 skills, a one-click reset button, and a 3-tier priority diagnostic chain displa"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ying environment variables, profile patches, and built-in fallbacks with their active hit states."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The level segmented control reflects only the actual persisted configuration. When `defaultMode` is "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"not configured in the patch, the control highlights the appended `unset` segment. The currently acti"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ve runtime level is displayed distinctly in the diagnostic header text."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Configuration reads and writes use two official DSH channels:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Channel | Scope | Target |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `ctx.configForms.get('ponytail')` | Default level & disabled skills with revision conflict checkin"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"g | `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` |
| `ctx.remote.ponytail.snapshot()` | Active runtime level &"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" 3-tier diagnostic chain (read-only) | In-memory RPC |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Profiles lacking a full UI service bundle (headless, CLI) fall back gracefully to `profiles/<name>/p"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"onytail/config.json`, fully aligned with the latest DSH pure profile architecture."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Upstream Mapping"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The six hooks from upstream `hooks/` are consolidated into a single DSH Cordis plugin:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Upstream | DSH Implementation |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `ponytail-config.js` | `src/ponytail-config.ts` |
| `ponytail-instructions.js` | `src/ponytail-ins"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"tructions.ts` (single entrypoint `renderPromptSection`) |
| `ponytail-state.js` | `src/ponytail-stat"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"e.ts` (flag file I/O, session baseline manager, reload) |
| `ponytail-activate.js` | `src/ponytail.t"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"s` (`agent/created` hook) |
| `ponytail-mode-tracker.js` | `src/ponytail-commands.ts` (`createComman"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"dDispatcher`) |
| `ponytail-subagent.js` | `src/ponytail.ts` (`agent/created`, `PONYTAIL_SUBAGENT_MA"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"er`) |
| `ponytail-subagent.js` | `src/ponytail.ts` (`agent/created`, `PONYTAIL_SUBAGENT_MATCHER`) |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Prompts are injected via `systemPrompt.section('ponytail')` at `order: 50`, positioned neatly betwee"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"n `persona` (0) and tools (100). When switched to `off`, prompt rendering overhead is zero. Flags an"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"d configurations are scoped per profile directory, ensuring full multi-instance isolation."}],"truncated":true}
